name: Qwen
summary: Alibaba's Qwen family of open and hosted models with a public chat app and developer APIs.
description: Qwen is Alibaba Cloud's line of large language and multimodal models. The qwen.ai site offers a consumer chat experience, while developers deploy the same models through APIs and open weights on Hugging Face.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Free chat on qwen.ai; API and cloud pricing via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

features: Multimodal Qwen models for text, vision, and code.
Qwen Chat web app with file and image input.
Model Studio API for production workloads.

howToUse.title: Try Qwen Chat
howToUse.description: Open qwen.ai and start a conversation or upload an image for vision tasks.

howToUse.title: Pick a model tier
howToUse.description: Select the model size or capability shown in the UI for harder reasoning or faster replies.

howToUse.title: Integrate via API
howToUse.description: Create credentials in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio if you need programmatic access.

features_fr: Modèles Qwen multimodaux pour le texte, la vision et le code.
Application Web Qwen Chat avec saisie de fichiers et d'images.
API Model Studio pour les charges de travail de production.
